tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background, behind everything (body).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panes: sidebar, titlebar, context menu, settings cards.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: hover on secondary buttons and rows, skeletons, the status bar.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Strongest text: titles, the brand name, selected rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface and soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, hints, captions.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: counts, footnotes, empty-state lines. Not for text that must be read (low contrast on purpose).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between sections and rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and cards: secondary buttons, menus, steps.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Track behind a progress bar or an unfilled field.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, focus ring, the mark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done and verified: the check in "nothing missing", finished steps.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Something missing or waiting: the subtitle turns this colour when files are missing. Light value 4.9:1 on bg, so it holds as text and icon.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Failures: a stopped download, a refused sign-in.

tokens.name: folder
tokens.usage: Folder icons, as the system draws them.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: The small highlight chip in the titlebar.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected or active background tinted with accent: current row, menu hover.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an ok banner.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning banner.

tokens.name: err-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner.

tokens.name: surface-clear
tokens.usage: surface at zero alpha, the end of a fade over surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog or a menu; the shade at a photo tile's edges under its badges.

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Text and icons over a photo or the viewer, whatever the theme.

tokens.name: on-photo-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text over a photo or the viewer.

tokens.name: on-photo-soft
tokens.usage: A button's fill over a photo or the viewer.

tokens.name: viewer-bg
tokens.usage: The photo viewer and the system bars around it.

tokens.name: on-chip
tokens.usage: Text on the chip.

tokens.name: google-tile
tokens.usage: The white tile behind Google's G, as Google's branding asks.

styles.name: text-hero
styles.usage: The largest figure: a count shown alone.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Display headings.

styles.name: text-large-title
styles.usage: Page titles of the first run.

styles.name: text-title-1
styles.usage: Page titles.

styles.name: text-title-2
styles.usage: Section titles.

styles.name: text-title-3
styles.usage: Brand name, Google button, small titles.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Default UI text and buttons.

styles.name: text-callout
styles.usage: Small buttons, secondary lines.

styles.name: text-subheadline
styles.usage: Captions, sidebar group labels.

styles.name: text-footnote
styles.usage: The smallest text: footnotes, badges.

groups.name: Phone scale
groups.note: iOS's text styles at the default size, line heights on the 4px grid. The phone app uses only these, the same on Android and iOS.

styles.name: text-phone-large-title
styles.usage: Phone: the screen's answer, its largest line.

styles.name: text-phone-title-1
styles.usage: Phone: a big figure under the answer.

styles.name: text-phone-title-2
styles.usage: Phone: titles of a pushed screen.

styles.name: text-phone-title-3
styles.usage: Phone: section titles.

styles.name: text-phone-headline
styles.usage: Phone: buttons, the bar's labels, row titles (semibold).

styles.name: text-phone-body
styles.usage: Phone: default text.

styles.name: text-phone-callout
styles.usage: Phone: secondary lines under a title.

styles.name: text-phone-subheadline
styles.usage: Phone: row details, small buttons, month headings.

styles.name: text-phone-footnote
styles.usage: Phone: counts, pills, notes.

styles.name: text-phone-caption
styles.usage: Phone: the smallest text: badges, file names.

spacing.note: The steps the app uses today; the .pen holds no spacing variables.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Compact rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap in groups.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: The sides of a desktop button.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between groups on a page.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Small marks, thumbnails in lists.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Tiles inside buttons, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Small buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: The Google sign-in button.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-24
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus on the phone.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, progress bars.

size.note: Fixed sizes of phone parts, the same on Android and iOS, on the 4px grid.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: The smallest thing a finger presses, on Android and iOS: bar buttons, small buttons, list leads.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: The phone's top bar.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: The phone's primary button.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: A list row with a detail or a thumbnail: 12 + 48 + 12.

tokens.name: size-row-single
tokens.usage: A one-line list row.

tokens.name: size-icon-tile
tokens.usage: The round state tile above a phone screen's answer.

tokens.name: size-hero
tokens.usage: The tinted circle of a one-task screen (pairing, permission, empty).

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: The account avatar in the phone's top bar.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside controls and the status bar.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and on photo tiles.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in bars, the bottom nav and lists.

tokens.name: size-icon-hero
tokens.usage: The icon of a one-task screen.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: The phone's bottom bar: a 24 icon, 4, a 16 label, centred.

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: The phone's status bar, drawn by the OS.

tokens.name: size-gesture
tokens.usage: The phone's gesture bar, drawn by the OS.

tokens.name: size-switch-w
tokens.usage: A switch's track width.

tokens.name: size-switch-h
tokens.usage: A switch's track height.

tokens.name: size-switch-thumb
tokens.usage: A switch's thumb.

tokens.name: size-statusbar-ios
tokens.usage: iPhone status bar, drawn by the OS.

tokens.name: size-home-ios
tokens.usage: iPhone home indicator area, drawn by the OS.

tokens.name: size-scan-frame
tokens.usage: The square the camera looks through to read the computer's code.

tokens.name: size-slot-w
tokens.usage: Desktop table: the action slot every row has.

tokens.name: size-slot-h
tokens.usage: Desktop table: the action pill's height.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: A status dot.

tokens.name: size-table-name
tokens.usage: Desktop table: the name column.

weight.note: Font weights. Every weight in a component is one of these.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body, counts.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Nav labels.

tokens.name: weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Row titles, headings, buttons.

tokens.name: weight-bold
tokens.usage: Screen answers, bar titles, the brand.

shadow.note: Elevation. Only floating things cast a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: The primary button's edge.

tokens.name: shadow-google
tokens.usage: Google's sign-in button.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers on the desktop.

motion.note: Durations and curves. Pages change at once; what moves is a block coming or going, a dialog, a list. Nothing moves under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press, a small change of state; a block leaving.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: A block appearing, a banner, a dialog, the sidebar, a list's rows moving.

tokens.name: motion-wait
tokens.usage: How long a load may take before its skeleton shows.

tokens.name: motion-ambient
tokens.usage: Slow ambient change: the arriving photos crossfading, a progress bar filling.

tokens.name: motion-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of a spinner: something under way.

tokens.name: motion-pulse
tokens.usage: One breath of a pulsing dot, the opening mark, a skeleton's shimmer.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entering and moving: quick, then settling.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Leaving.
